title: RegulatoryFeasibilityItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-vision-regulatory-feasibility-checker. items carries META POINTS about regulatory-feasibility.md, not the full document — full rationale/mitigation narrative lives ONLY in the artifact, saved to blob storage. '_summary' fields are short distillations (<=~20 words, slightly longer budget than other agents since a mitigation must remain actionable even in short form). Status, citation, id, requires_legal_review and the whole viability object are structural facts, not prose duplication, and stay in full. Every constraint is a primary category and MUST carry a citation. Every Amber/Red constraint MUST carry a mitigation_summary or an explicit requires_legal_review flag — a Red constraint with no mitigation_summary and requires_legal_review=false is an invalid output, not a stylistic gap. v2.0 folds in the viability score formerly produced by L1-vision-viability-scorer: this agent now owns qg-L1-viability-score, and L1-vision-statement-generator receives viability.viability_score as an input parameter it is forbidden from computing or adjusting.

rationale_summary.description: Short distillation — full rationale is in regulatory-feasibility.md's Feasibility Summary

categories_not_applicable.description: One entry per Regulatory Scenario Coverage category that was swept and found not to apply. A swept category is either a constraint or an entry here — never silently absent

source_reference.description: KB chunk id (e.g. kb-L2-domain-regulatory#allergen-labelling) or regulatory-db lookup reference

regulation.description: The specific named regulation/section — not prose, kept in full

name.description: Constraint name — short label, not prose, kept in full

rationale_summary.description: Short distillation — full rationale is in the artifact

mitigation_summary.description: Short, still-actionable distillation. Required (non-null) if status is Amber or Red, unless requires_legal_review is true. Full mitigation detail is in the artifact.

category.description: The swept category name, e.g. 'Financial crime (AML/KYC)'

reason.description: <=20 words — why this idea does not trigger the category

Viability.description: The viability score this agent owns at qg-L1-viability-score. Derived from the regulatory posture it just assessed and the clarity of idea-brief.json — no market component, since the market analyzer runs in parallel and may not have run at all. A Red constraint or a requires_legal_review flag always caps the score below the threshold of 7, so an unresolved regulatory blocker cannot be outvoted by a clearly written idea.

viability_score.description: The final score, one decimal place, equal to score_derivation.final_score. Never rounded up across the threshold — 6.95 is reported as 6.9

recommendation.description: A statement of where the score falls against the threshold, not a decision — the workflow decides on auto-publish

final_score.description: The lowest of weighted_score and every cap that fired

capped.description: true when at least one cap fired — i.e. caps_applied is non-empty. A ceiling that was in force but did not bind (weighted_score was already below it) is still recorded as capped, so the constraint that triggered it stays visible. weighted_score and final_score are both kept, so the gap, or its absence, is never hidden

caps_applied.description: Empty when the weighted score stands. Each entry records a ceiling that fired and what triggered it. When more than one fires, final_score is the LOWEST cap value

allOf.description: A fired cap must be reflected in the final score
Recommendation must agree with the score it reports on

score.description: Never null — both inputs are always present on a successful run, since a missing idea-brief.json is INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT rather than a partial score

confidence.description: Lowered, not the score, when the idea brief is thin — thinness is a confidence problem, not a viability problem

traced_to.description: The CON-NN ids, or the idea-brief.json fields, behind the score — references, not prose

reasoning.description: <=40 words. Full rationale is in regulatory-feasibility.md's Viability Score section

rule.description: red_constraint and regulatory_overall_red cap at 6.0; requires_legal_review at 6.5 — both below the threshold of 7

triggered_by.description: The CON-NN ids that triggered the cap
